design.authorization: 2026-10-27 사용자: 정상 n개 포함/제외 학습 및 정상 포함/공격만 평가를 정제 전후에 비교하는 합의안에 대해 '이렇게 실험 진행해줘'
design.sampling: Uniform without replacement, 20 rows per class using the EXP86 class-specific RNG; nested n prefixes. Clean attack IDs reproduce EXP86. Attack IDs are identical with and without benign, and both models receive identical IDs. Original and clean pools differ; same seed is paired but their sampled IDs need not coincide.
design.original_definition: Same source features, family labels and original outer split IDs; disable conflict-row removal only. No new split, feature engineering or normalization fitted to the full pool.
design.evaluation: Every model predicts the entire original fixed test once. Original/clean population and all/attack-only views are masks of those same predictions. Predicting benign on a true attack remains an error; never remove output classes or renormalize.
design.query_protocol: Full original test, label-independent seed43 permutation, batch8192, identical across all conditions. No test subsampling or deduplication. Existing predictions use different query batches and are continuity references only.
design.metrics: Attack Macro-F1 in every view; all-class Macro-F1 only comparable on a fixed population and class set; per-class precision/recall/F1/TP/FP/FN, benign FPR and attack-to-benign errors. Attack-only-trained full-test scores are structural diagnostics with benign FPR=1.
design.models: Unchanged EXP86 XGB300/depth8/lr.05/subsample.8/colsample.8/min_child_weight1 and frozen TabPFN-v3/4 estimators/fit_with_cache/CPU cache/no context subsampling; no hyperparameter search or FT.
design.contrasts: Benign training on fixed attack rows; benign test inclusion for a fixed model; train curation on original fixed test; test curation for fixed model. Seed-paired deltas, mean and sample SD; original versus clean test changes the target population.
design.cost: Fresh construct+fit/cache, full-original-test inference and validation overhead reported separately. No sequential updates or cross-run inference-cost comparisons.
design.report: Independent prediction/ID/metric verification, Korean standalone LaTeX, plots and CSVs, one-line lablog; temporary PDF compilation. Automatic partial/failure record and finalization.
design.adoption: Exploratory previously inspected split; execution success is not manuscript adoption. No version transition, manuscript or slide changes.
